💡 This work introduces a triple-coupling strategy—solvation, interfacial chemistry, and crystallographic orientation—via a formamide-ethanol deep eutectic electrolyte. این مقاله یک کاتد پلیمر کوئوردیناسیون مزدوج π-d را برای باتری‌های آلومینیومی قابل شارژ معرفی می‌کند که چرخه‌پذیری طولانی و ظرفیت بالا دارد.
Journal of Materials Chemistry A | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in a 3D π–d conjugated Fe₂(DHBQ)₃ cathode enabling electron delocalization, suppressed dissolution, and synergistic AlCl₂⁺ binding, Fe redox, and EMIm⁺ π-interactions. Its significance is exceptional durability—110.7 mAh g⁻¹ over 40,000 cycles at 2 A g⁻¹—and electrolyte versatility, supporting low-cost molten-salt electrolytes for practical rechargeable aluminum batteries.

item.title: Two Faces of the Same Oxide: How Crystal Phase Defines the Nature of Proton Storage in MoO3
item.description:

💡 This study reveals how MoO3 crystal phase dictates proton-storage mechanisms: α-MoO3 enables reversible lattice breathing and multivalent redox for battery-type storage, while h-MoO3 degrades into pseudocapacitive behavior. item.title: Automatic Generation of Inorganic Solid‐State Electrolytes via Unified Multi‐Modal Network
item.description:

💡 USMNet unifies crystal-structure, compositional, and physical descriptors to predict Li-ion conductivity, overcoming sparse data and structure dependence. Experimental validation confirms Li₁₆ZnSiP₂S₁₆ delivers 80% capacity retention after 600 cycles, demonstrating a generalizable, closed-loop strategy for solid-state electrolyte discovery.

item.title: Harnessing Anion Perturbation for Self‐Limiting Decomposition for Durable Argyrodite‐Based Solid‐State Lithium Metal Batteries
item.description:

💡 Fluorozirconate incorporation perturbs PS₄³⁻ anions in argyrodite electrolytes, deliberately triggering controlled decomposition to form a self-limiting, Li₂S/LiₓP- and F-rich SEI. This shifts the paradigm from suppressing to harnessing decomposition. The robust, insulating interphase enables 7000 h Li||Li cycling and 81.3% capacity retention after 1200 cycles, offering a facile strategy for durable solid-state lithium metal batteries.

This approach yields electrochemically stable, high-capacity solid electrolytes, particularly [B12H12]2– compounds compatible with high-voltage cathodes, advancing safe, high-energy-density battery technology.
